events.title: Patrick Wolff's "Swinging Organ" Quartet
events.description: Patrick Wolff's newest band is a swinging organ quartet that draws from the style of the late 50s/early 60s collaborations of Shirley Scott/ "Lockjaw" Davis and Lou Donaldson/ Big John Patton. Featuring two of the Bay's experts in this idiom, pianist/organist Adam Shulman and guitarist Jack Tone Riordan, and the talented up and coming drummer Miles Turk, [...]
